Your job Together with your colleagues, you will ensure that hotel rooms and public areas are clean, fresh, and well-presented every day. Thanks to your efforts, guests enjoy a great first impression and a comfortable stay. Your responsibilities Cleaning hotel rooms and bathrooms Making beds and changing bed linen Vacuuming, mopping, and dusting surfaces Replenishing soap, shampoo, and guest amenities Keeping hallways and public areas clean and tidy The best part of the job? You can immediately see the results of your work and make a direct contribution to guest satisfaction every day. Working hours Working hours between 09:00 AM and 05:00 PM Flexible working days from Monday to Sunday, by mutual agreement Both part-time and full-time opportunities available This role is ideal if you are looking for an active daytime job with a healthy work-life balance. EW Facility Services For more than 30 years, EW Facility Services has been providing cleaning and maintenance services for hotels, offices, healthcare facilities, and other locations throughout the Netherlands. With over 3,000 colleagues nationwide, we are committed to delivering quality, hospitality, and excellent service every day. Together, we create clean, safe, and welcoming environments for guests, visitors, and employees. You are Availablto work flexibly from Monday to Sunday Able to work independently and take responsibility Fluent in Dutch and/or English Detail-oriented with a strong sense of cleanliness Living in or near Noordwijkerhout, or able to travel easily to the hotel Previous cleaning experience is a plus, but not required. We will gladly teach you everything you need to know! Apply Can you picture yourself working with the friendly team at NH Hotel Leeuwenhorst in Noordwijkerhout? Don't wait any longer and apply today. We look forward to welcoming you as our new Housekeeping Attendant!

Are you ready to earn €16,30 per hour and work together with your partner, sibling or friend? Then this might be the perfect job for you! For Jingdong Logistics, a logistic company in Venray, we are looking for warehouse employees / orderpickers in 2 shifts. Jingdong Logistics is one of the largest Asian logistics companies and is expanding into Europe. They work with innovative techniques in the brand new and modern warehouse in Venray. The warehouse is for the distribution of a well known lingerie brand. Will you be part of the growth of Jingdong Logistics? Wie zoeken we? What do you need for the job as a warehouse employee? You can speak English You are able to work in 2 shifts You are available from Monday to Sunday You have your own accommodation You have your own transportation (car) or live in or nearby Venray so that you can also travel by bicycle or scooter. The company is not reachable by public transport Wat bieden wij je? What can you expect as a warehouse employee / orderpicker? Salary of €16,30 gross per hour including shift allowance Travel allowance Extra allowances during the weekend (Saturday 150% and Sunday 200%) Long-term job at an innovative logistic company Functieomschrijving As a warehouse employee / order picker at Jingdong Logistics in Venray, you’ll never have a bored moment. In this full-time role, you can work side by side with your best friend; making the days fly by! The company operates from Monday to Sunday, with shifts from 06:00 to 15:00 and 15:00 to 00:00. You’ll work in a 2-shift system, giving you plenty of time to enjoy your free hours too. And don’t worry about getting exhausted; many of the orders are handled by robots and automated systems, making your job much lighter. Sounds perfect, right? Your tasks as a warehouse employee include: Process orders before shipping Packing orders Prepare and check shipments Quality control Apply Are you interested in this position as a warehouse employee? Then apply directly!
